archetypes.name: allowlist-sync
archetypes.rationale: The plan requires lockstep edits across three separate surfaces (TSV, code heredoc, docs); drift between them is both a named failure mode and an undetected risk if any surface is missed.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify that every planned allowlist addition — bail_reason rows for bug-body/bug-comment/chat-print and the exit_code transform change from integer to integer-or-unknown — appears consistently across all three surfaces: stall-recovery-report-allowlists.tsv, the code_allowlist_lines() heredoc in stall-recovery-report.sh, and the allowlist table in stall-recovery-report.md. Check that integer-or-unknown is a recognized transform type in the allowlist validation logic — a new type name the validator does not know will silently pass linting while failing at runtime. Look for any surface that lists rows in a different order or uses a different column format, since the lint-parity test assumes structural equivalence. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bail-reason-enum-parity
archetypes.rationale: The plan claims safe_bail_reason_value is a closed enum, lists 10 specific values for SECURITY.md, and requires those values to be reconciled with the actual function body; any mismatch silently leaks a redacted placeholder or exposes an unlisted token.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the existing safe_bail_reason_value() function in stall-recovery-report.sh and extract its current closed-enum set; compare that set against the 10-value list the plan proposes to document in stall-recovery-report.md and SECURITY.md. Flag any value present in the code but absent from the plan's documented list, or vice versa, since both would cause either silent redaction of a valid token or undocumented exposure. Check whether the plan introduces any new bail-reason tokens via SKILL.md prose changes that are not yet in safe_bail_reason_value, which would cause the new bail_reason table row to render redacted even when correctly plumbed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: step2-bail-completeness
archetypes.rationale: The plan targets specific SKILL.md sections (§2.1.5 and §2.2 STATUS=bailed) but SKILL.md is prose, so other Step-2 hard-bail branches may exist that the plan's named sites omit.
archetypes.prompt_body: Read SKILL.md and enumerate all Step-2 sites that set FINAL_BAIL_REASON or route to Step 12d; compare that full set against the plan's explicitly named sites (§2.1.5 envelope-invalid and §2.2 STATUS=bailed). Any Step-2 bail site not listed in the plan but present in the file would send a stall to Step 18a with IMPLEMENT_BAIL_REASON unset, causing the fallback chain to yield an empty bail reason and a none-rendered table cell even when the actual failure class is known. Also check whether the plan's instruction to set STALL_TRACKING=true unconditionally at §2.2 STATUS=bailed could conflict with any existing conditional that already gates stall tracking, producing double-reporting or no reporting depending on evaluation order. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
